label: Remap Curve
author: Conky-Studio
description: Map 0–1 (or any range) through ease-in / ease-out / smoothstep / gamma. Makes bars and glows feel less linear.
lua_expr:
(function()
 local v = tonumber({value}) or 0
 local imin, imax = {in_min}, {in_max}
 local omin, omax = {out_min}, {out_max}
 local span = imax - imin; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local t = (v - imin) / span; if t < 0 then t = 0 elseif t > 1 then t = 1 end
 local c = {curve}
 if c == 'ease_in' then t = t * t
 elseif c == 'ease_out' then t = 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t)
 elseif c == 'smoothstep' then t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
 elseif c == 'gamma' then t = t ^ ({gamma})
 end
 return omin + (omax - omin) * t
end)()
